assessment: This paper uses flow cytometry to characterize the changes in immune cell composition of the peripheral blood, as well as DNA methylation, during aging in male rats. Using this data, the authors were able to observe distinct cell composition and DNA methylation profiles with age, providing predictive measures of aging. Additionally, the authors identified a novel marker, CD25+ T cell frequency, as a predictor of age in rats. This resource will be useful to the community as a well-controlled dataset dissecting changes in circulating blood cells with aging in an important mammalian model.
